scope: All runtime shared fixed/numbered vocabulary plus every emit/say/candidate add callsite in listed live modules; includes dynamic dispatch and explicit preview/question-only vocabulary.

runtime_contract.question_audio: Explicit microphone/text answers use whole synthesized measured reply in RAM; no private disk cache.
runtime_contract.automatic_audio: Whole existing cached sentences only. Preferred missing variant falls back to cached equivalent whole variant. Seed advances only after completed delivery ACK. No runtime TTS, numeric clips or guessed data.
runtime_contract.formation: Multipart whole-sentence playback at fixed1.15x, common spotter formation count0..8; available topic count may be lower than configured maximum.

families.iracing_conditions: SDK flag rising edge; blue held 1.5s and first-race-lap traffic confirmation; qualifying solo flags suppressed. Flags expire when their live bit no longer applies.
families.lmu_mapping_or_blocker: Observed native green/blue/yellow/FCY edges. YellowFlagState5 is explicitly last caution lap. Observed race phase1/2/3->4 permits start_set countdown wait, withdrawn at green or after5s. No lamp-frame mapping, iRacing masks or unverified primary enum. Own terminal finish/DQ edge only.

families.iracing_conditions: Counter boundary plus independently updated last time; clean lap and real best improvement for personal best; >=3 prior clean laps and >=.7s median change for pace; 3 consecutive clean laps spread<=.3s for consistent; qualifying result waits1.5s for same-class bests; race result crosses line under checkered.
families.lmu_mapping_or_blocker: Reconciled scoring-confirmed lap boundary, clean diagnostic for best/pace. Qualifying result waits1.5s, requires complete known same-class rows and actual best times; equal-time ties are not guessed. Last-lap time and qualifying standing currently remain separate calls.

families.iracing_conditions: Race running, changed class place held5s, outside pits,15s cooldown; speak actual place/up/down.
families.lmu_mapping_or_blocker: Published class position stable5s outside pit, numeric up/down whole sentence. Immediate position available on explicit measured question.

families.iracing_conditions: Track temperature change>=4C,300s cooldown. Native iRacing wetness crosses2/3 for wet/dry. Rain tyre instructions require known fitted compound plus wet declaration; unknown compound only measured very-wet state.
families.lmu_mapping_or_blocker: Native physical wetness0 vs positive and4degree temperature changes. Dry tyre return advice requires actual known front+rear wet compounds and wetness falling to0; no arbitrary positive ratio becomes rain severity. Rain-box thresholds remain unavailable.

families.iracing_conditions: At least measured clean-lap consumption. Fuel-critical compares fuel remaining after current lap with1.3-lap margin; if stop needed5-lap/2-lap calls; measured race distance controls finish shortfall, reserve, next stop liters/full-tank, fuel-save feasible/target and feedback, pit window and extra finish lap. Refuel selection checked against needed amount. Direct low-fuel warning uses max(.5L,half clean-lap consumption) and near-dry .5L stages.
families.lmu_mapping_or_blocker: Shared RaceEngineer measured lap-limit and timed finish projection, stop/fill/reserve/window/rejoin/halfway/extra-lap math. Requires2 complete clean observed fuel laps, clean own pace, fresh scoring; user pit loss for projected rejoin. Actual saving target frozen at observed lap start joins the exact clean fuel lap_start_et for fuel_lap and3-consecutive-lap fuel_save_held. Gaps, pit, invalid signal, refuel, options or identity changes reset feedback. REST Virtual Energy percentage and Fuel Ratio are not selected liters; no invented fill setting.

families.iracing_conditions: Known pit entry/exit edges; speed>official limit+3km/h; limiter-off in pit; actual service status transitions; stall-position status codes; tow countdown. Pit-box distance requires consistent local movement and official box position; cross nearest unspoken threshold150/100/50/20/10m,0.8s TTL.
families.lmu_mapping_or_blocker: Observed pit and limiter edges. Native own pit-box projection feeds existing movement/jump check and200/100/50/20/10m crossings with0.8s TTL. Fixed local GET RepairAndRefuel supplies current tyre selection and selected stop estimate only after matching vehicle/fuel/freshness. In-pit observed tyre selection changes and entry use shared tyre_setting_on/off; expired REST result cancels immediately. Request/stopped remains display-only; no service completion, official speed-limit, repair or tow inference.

families.iracing_conditions: At least4s same-point progress history for closing>=.02s/s and drop>=.15s; multiclass pace/lapped status; close behind<=.5s and rearm>=.8s; hazard1.5..10s ahead, offtrack2 observations or speed<35% usual. Race battle reports>=3 line gaps shrinking>.15s/lap and currentgap<8s; faster rival behind<5s and>=3 lap pace.
families.lmu_mapping_or_blocker: Native class IDs/total laps/distance/published last+best times feed shared race engineer. High-rate collector reuses original1Hz approach/hazard/close-behind monitors, precise scoring clock. Hazard surface is approximate PathLateral/TrackEdge geometry, explicitly not official validity. Events revalidate same target/current hazard immediately before playback. Same-class line-gap closing requires original history thresholds.

families.iracing_conditions: SDK warning risingbits while moving; delayed detail only while warning persists; incidents increment and proximity to official incident limit; after contact observe complete clean-lap pace/vmax/steering before damage comparison; repair offer/time and fuel time required for repair cost/gain.
families.lmu_mapping_or_blocker: Actual overheating rising edge held5s while moving permits only generic warning_detail; no oil/water-specific cause inferred. Observed fresh new impact enables shared clean post-contact pace/vmax/physical steering comparison. Pit or refuel resets stint history even with unknown traffic. Wheel/penalty facts remain display-only; no repair/tow channels.

families.iracing_conditions: Clean unbroken section vs observed clean best, non-clean traffic/yellow/incident/gaps excluded; confirmed corner names; >=.1s worst loss and reminder6..12s before baseline brake. Lap review, theoretical best/delta/rival sectors only after their measured section histories exist. Long-straight report must fit learned speech window and pending calls.
families.lmu_mapping_or_blocker: Validated LMU workspace geometry registered for exact car/track identity. Shared LiveCornerCoach consumes actual scoring clock with duplicates ignored, complete clean traffic/validity evidence, no gaps and sufficient pre-brake speech margin. Confirmed names use corner_call; others use corner_focus.20-sector theoretical/delta, corner loss/gain, ended-stint average and actual ahead/leader lap now feed measured straight brief automation. Qualifying permits corner/delta/theoretical only. Targets, lap, gap, workload and expiry revalidated.

families.iracing_conditions: 3 complete clean laps, known brake-bias/TC/ABS setting and steering/yaw sign learning; repeated countersteer under brake/power calls more intervention. ABS>=50% brake duty advises driver pressure in display, not setting change.
families.lmu_mapping_or_blocker: Shared3-clean-lap ControlAdvisor receives real yaw/settings and physical wheel angle only when SDK physical range exists. Normalized steering ratio is never radians. Missing physical angle or complete traffic makes evidence unavailable. Current sampled vehicle has physical angle missing and therefore no countersteer claim.

families.iracing_conditions: At least2 driver notes on separate laps near same section in current run; a reminder follows latest note location; driver wording selects entry/exit advice. Not a telemetry diagnosis or setup-learning evidence.
families.lmu_mapping_or_blocker: Explicit present driver complaints from F8/text capture are canonical category/entry/exit/location/lap facts in bounded RAM only, no transcript or recording persisted. Capture<=12s and exact recording/session/vehicle required. Shared RaceEngineer requires same location within1percent on2 distinct laps and current-lap1.5..6percent progress after latest complaint;300s cooldown. No telemetry diagnosis, hypothetical/negated/quoted/past statement, or setup-learning evidence.

families.iracing_conditions: Race formation rolling>=5m/s outside pit, measured lap progress schedules topics. Only known values spoken; race length/grid/class count/fuel/weather/history/rules plus brief sendoff. iRating/SOF/rating goal require real iRacing ratings.
families.lmu_mapping_or_blocker: Existing topic pack and whole cached sentences. Native race phase3, speed>=5m/s outside pit; actual progress schedules up to user0..8 calls, no invented progress if unavailable. Ordinary briefing bypasses weaving/braking hold, never occupied spotter. ACK only after completed playback; unheard/expired topic retried. Read-only indexed latest compatible source history supplies fastest eligible lap and measured temperature comparison; source signature/exact car/track/layout/rain category checked. Topics rotate when configured count is limited. iRating/SOF/incident, measured cold tyres, visit count, prior rank and historical corner-loss claims excluded.

families.iracing_conditions: User-enabled section drill lifecycle; measured warmup transitions, stored section target and completed repetitions. Beep position comes from live distance, not a race flag.
families.lmu_mapping_or_blocker: LMU saved practice tasks currently provide post-drive repeatability comparisons. Existing iRacing live drill uses Active Reset storage and cannot be transplanted. Ordinary-lap task activation UI/API, live target kernel and completion contract must be implemented before live drill voices; collecting laps alone is insufficient.

families.iracing_conditions: Explicit voice preview button; fixed approved role introduction, no live claim.
families.lmu_mapping_or_blocker: Every existing fixed/numbered/overlap variant is visible and can play its exact selected cached whole MP3. Missing clips return409; preview never synthesizes.

global_policy.iracing: priority3 fuel urgent; priority2 flags; overlap priority3; driver question priority4 protected. General reports wait workload, important excludes priority1, cooldown after confirmed delivery; pending validity rechecked before playback.

Wheel/penalty facts remain display-only; no repair/tow channels.

raw_trigger_callsites.call: self.emit(key, now, built['text'], role=options.pop('role', built['engineer']), speech_text=built['text'], **options)

self.emit(hazard['kind'], now, priority=2, ttl=3, condition=('hazard', (hazard['idx'], hazard['kind'])),
                      cooldown=15, group='hazard')

enclosing_conditions: str(self.metadata.get('session_type', '')).lower() == 'race' and state in (1, 2, 3) and not self.briefed
raw_trigger_callsites.call: self.emit('briefing', now, self.briefing(), ttl=120, condition=('pre_race', None), cooldown=3600)

enclosing_conditions: state == 4 and previous.get('session_state') in (1, 2, 3) and flags is not None and not int(flags) & (0x4 | 0x80000000)
raw_trigger_callsites.call: self.emit('race_started', now, '경기 상태로 전환됐습니다. 출발 신호는 게임에서 확인하세요.', priority=1, cooldown=3600)

enclosing_conditions: threshold is not None and self.pit_box_enabled
raw_trigger_callsites.call:
self.emit(f'pit_box_{threshold}', now, priority=2, ttl=.8,
                      condition=('pit_box', threshold), cooldown=0, group='pit_box')

enclosing_conditions: old is not None and old <= 2 < wet
raw_trigger_callsites.call: self.say('track_wet_start', now, priority=2, condition=('wet', (3, 7)), cooldown=120, ttl=20, group='track_state')

enclosing_conditions:
not self.result_called and str(self.metadata.get('session_type', '')).lower() == 'race'
                and int(sample.get('session_flags') or 0) & 0x1 and int(previous.get('session_flags') or 0) & 0x1
                and lap is not None and old_lap is not None and lap == old_lap + 1 and position is not None and position > 0
raw_trigger_callsites.call: self.say('race_result', now, {'pos': position}, ttl=40, delay=3, cooldown=3600)

enclosing_conditions:
self.latest.get('session_state') in (1, 2, 3)
                and str(self.metadata.get('session_type', '')).lower() == 'race'
                and self.last_sample is not None and 0 <= now - self.last_sample < .5
                and not any(e['key'] == 'briefing' and self.valid(e, now) for e in self.pending)
raw_trigger_callsites.call: self.emit('briefing', now, self.briefing(), ttl=120, condition=('pre_race', None), cooldown=120)

enclosing_conditions: pit is True and old is False
raw_trigger_callsites.call: self.emit('pit_enter', now, priority=2, condition=('pit', True), cooldown=5)

enclosing_conditions: pit is False and old is True
raw_trigger_callsites.call: self.emit('pit_exit', now, priority=2, condition=('pit', False), ttl=5, cooldown=5)

enclosing_conditions: pit is True and speed is not None and limit is not None and speed * 3.6 > limit + PIT_SPEED_MARGIN_KPH
raw_trigger_callsites.call: self.emit('pit_speed', now, priority=2, ttl=3, condition=('overspeed', None), cooldown=8)

enclosing_conditions: pit is True and warnings is not None and old_warnings is not None and int(old_warnings) & 0x10 and not int(warnings) & 0x10
raw_trigger_callsites.call: self.emit('limiter_off', now, priority=2, condition=('limiter_off', None), cooldown=10)

enclosing_conditions: tow is not None and tow > 0 and old_tow is not None and old_tow <= 0
raw_trigger_callsites.call:
self.emit('tow', now, f'견인 중입니다. 표시된 남은 시간은 약 {tow:.0f}초입니다.', condition=('tow', None),
                      speech_text=self.wording('tow_time', sec=tow))

enclosing_conditions: stage > self.fuel_low_stage and fuel >= 0 and s.get('session_state') in (4, 5) and not int(s.get('session_flags') or 0) & 1
raw_trigger_callsites.call: self.emit('fuel_low', now, priority=2, condition=('low_fuel', None), cooldown=0)

enclosing_conditions: int(flags) & caution_mask and not int(old_flags or 0) & caution_mask
raw_trigger_callsites.call: self.emit('caution', now, priority=2, condition=('flag', caution_mask))
self.emit('green', now, priority=2, condition=('flag', 0x4 | 0x80000000), cooldown=10)

enclosing_conditions: self.damage_check_at is not None and now >= self.damage_check_at
warnings is not None and flags is not None and not int(warnings) & 0x180 and not int(flags) & 0x100000
raw_trigger_callsites.call: self.say('no_repair', now, role='race', condition=('racing', None), cooldown=120, ttl=12)

enclosing_conditions: old is not None and old <= 2 < wet
old is not None and wet <= 2 < old
raw_trigger_callsites.call: self.say('track_drying', now, condition=('wet', (1, 2)), cooldown=120, ttl=30, group='track_state')

self.say(advice, now, priority=2 if advice.startswith('rain_box') else 1, ttl=45,
                         condition=('rain_advice', advice), cooldown=90, group='rain_advice')

enclosing_conditions:
self.qualifying and lap is not None and lap != self.quali_called and self.lap_done_at is not None
                and now - self.lap_done_at >= 1.5 and (timed or now - self.lap_done_at >= 3.2)
raw_trigger_callsites.call:
self.emit(result[0] if result else timed['key'], now, ' '.join(screen), role='race' if result else 'spotter', ttl=40, cooldown=0,
                          group='lap_time', speech_text=' '.join(parts), speech_parts=parts)

enclosing_conditions: pit is True and status is not None and status != p.get('pit_service_status')
raw_trigger_callsites.call: self.emit(key, now, priority=2, condition=('service', status), cooldown=5)

enclosing_conditions: incidents is not None and old_incidents is not None and incidents > old_incidents
limit is not None and 0 < limit - incidents <= 8
raw_trigger_callsites.call:
self.say('incident_limit', now, {'points': incidents, 'left': limit - incidents},
                         priority=2 if limit - incidents <= 4 else 1, condition=('incidents', incidents), cooldown=8, group='incident')

enclosing_conditions: incidents is not None and old_incidents is not None and incidents > old_incidents
limit is not None and 0 < limit - incidents <= 8
raw_trigger_callsites.call: self.emit('incident', now, f'인시던트 누적 {int(incidents)}점입니다.', condition=('incidents', incidents), cooldown=8)

self.emit(key, now, priority=2, ttl=2, condition=('traffic', (car['idx'], key)),
                              cooldown=30, group='traffic_' + car['side'])
self.emit(key, now, priority=2, ttl=2, condition=('close', car['idx']), cooldown=20, group='traffic_behind')
self.emit(key, now, priority=priority, condition=('flag', bit), cooldown=10)

enclosing_conditions: int(flags) & caution_mask and not int(old_flags or 0) & caution_mask
int(flags) & yellow_mask and not int(old_flags or 0) & (yellow_mask | caution_mask)
raw_trigger_callsites.call: self.emit('yellow', now, priority=2, condition=('flag', yellow_mask))

enclosing_conditions: state == 4 and remaining is not None and old_remaining is not None
raw_trigger_callsites.call:
self.emit(f'time_{threshold}', now, f'경기 시간 약 {threshold // 60}분 남았습니다. 종료 후 마지막 랩은 게임 지시를 확인하세요.', condition=('racing', None), group='time_remaining', cooldown=3600,
                              speech_text=self.wording('time_left', min=threshold // 60))

self.say('track_temp_down' if temp < self.temp_reference else 'track_temp_up', now,
                         {'deg': abs(temp - self.temp_reference)}, cooldown=300, ttl=30, group='track_temp')

enclosing_conditions: incidents is not None and old_incidents is not None and incidents > old_incidents
raw_trigger_callsites.call: self.emit('incident_coaching', now, '최근 완주랩 사이에 인시던트가 늘었습니다. 원인은 아직 확인되지 않았습니다. 다음 랩은 평소보다 여유를 두고 달리고, 주행 후 문제 구간을 함께 확인하겠습니다.', role='coach', delay=6, cooldown=180, condition=('racing', None))

enclosing_conditions: now - self.position_since >= self.POSITION_SETTLE_S and getattr(self, 'position_changed', False)
raw_trigger_callsites.call:
self.emit('position', now, (f'현재 클래스 {int(position)}위입니다.', f'클래스 순위, {int(position)}위입니다.'), condition=('position', position), group='position', cooldown=15, ttl=POSITION_CALL_S,
                      speech_text=self.wording(wording, pos=position))

enclosing_conditions: warning is not None and old is not None and num(s.get('speed_mps')) is not None and s['speed_mps'] > 2
int(warning) & bit and not int(old) & bit
raw_trigger_callsites.call: self.emit(key, now, priority=2, condition=('warning', bit), cooldown=90)

enclosing_conditions: warning is not None and old is not None and num(s.get('speed_mps')) is not None and s['speed_mps'] > 2
int(warning) & bit and not int(old) & bit
raw_trigger_callsites.call: self.emit(key + '_detail', now, '차량 경고가 켜졌습니다. 경고 종류와 계기판을 확인하고 피트 또는 주행 중단 여부를 판단하세요. 이 신호만으로 고장 원인은 확정할 수 없습니다.', role='race', delay=5, condition=('warning', bit), cooldown=180, speech_key='warning_detail')

enclosing_conditions: now - self.blue_since >= BLUE_HOLD_S and not self.blue_called
raw_trigger_callsites.call: self.emit('blue', now, priority=2, condition=('blue', self.blue_since), cooldown=10)

enclosing_conditions: state == 4 and laps_left is not None and old_laps is not None
not (flags is not None and int(flags) & {10: 0x800, 5: 0x1000, 1: 0x2}.get(count, 0))
raw_trigger_callsites.call:
self.emit(f'laps_{count}', now, f'내 차량 기준 {count}랩 남았다는 표시입니다.', condition=('laps_left', count), group='laps_remaining', cooldown=3600,
                                  speech_text=self.wording('laps_left', laps=count))

enclosing_conditions: last is not None and 0 < last < 3600 and (last != completed['old_last'] or timer_reset)
raw_trigger_callsites.call:
self.emit(key, now, ' '.join(screen), ttl=min(LAP_CALL_MAX_S, max(45., last * LAP_CALL_SHARE)),
                              condition=('lap', lap), group='lap_time', cooldown=0,
                              speech_text=' '.join(parts), speech_parts=parts)

enclosing_conditions: last is not None and 0 < last < 3600 and (last != completed['old_last'] or timer_reset)

len(recent) == 3 and all(b['lap'] == a['lap'] + 1 for a, b in zip(recent, recent[1:]))
                            and max(l['time'] for l in recent) - min(l['time'] for l in recent) <= .3
raw_trigger_callsites.call: self.say('consistent', now, {'gap': max(.1, spread)}, condition=('lap', lap), delay=6, cooldown=300, ttl=40)

add('class_traffic', 'race', text, token=str(car['idx']), cooldown=120,
                short_text=f'다른 클래스 차량이 {label}에 있습니다.', speech_key='class_traffic_' + car['side'])

enclosing_conditions: fraction is not None and .5 <= fraction < .58 and view.get('class_position')
raw_trigger_callsites.call: add('halfway', 'race', cooldown=36000, phrase=('halfway', {'pos': view['class_position']}))

add('last_lap', 'race', priority=2, cooldown=36000,
                phrase=('last_lap_defend' if close('behind') else 'last_lap_attack' if close('ahead') else 'last_lap', {}))

add('fuel_feedback', 'strategy', text, token=f'{last["lap"]}:{last["mode"]}', cooldown=30,
                short_text='최근 3랩 연료 절약 목표 유지.' if held else f'방금 랩 연료 {last["use_l"]:.2f}리터. 목표 {last["target_l"]:.2f}리터.',
                speech_key='fuel_save_held' if held else None,
                phrase=None if held else ('fuel_lap', {'fuel': last['use_l'], 'target': last['target_l']}))

enclosing_conditions: gap is not None and gap < 8 and trend == 'closing' and car.get('gap_at_line_s') is not None
raw_trigger_callsites.call:
add(f'battle_{side}', 'race', short + f' 같은 위치에서 {car["gap_observations"]}회 관측한 추정입니다. 출발선 기준 간격 약 {car["gap_at_line_s"]:.1f}초입니다.',
                    token=f'{car["idx"]}:{trend}', cooldown=120, short_text=short,
                    phrase=(f'gap_{side}_closing', {'gap': car['gap_at_line_s']}))

enclosing_conditions: any(e['idx'] == car['idx'] and 0 <= snapshot['session_time'] - e['at'] <= 20 for e in self.pit_events)
raw_trigger_callsites.call: add(f'pit_{side}', 'race', f'같은 클래스 {label}의 피트 진입이 감지됐습니다.', 1, token=str(car['idx']))

enclosing_conditions:
len(laps - {None}) >= 2 and pct is not None and now_pct is not None
                    and snapshot.get('lap_number') == latest.get('lap_number') and .015 <= now_pct - pct <= .06
raw_trigger_callsites.call:
add('coach_reminder', 'coach', priority=1, token=f'{feeling}:{round(pct, 2)}', cooldown=300,
                    speech_key=call if call in CALLS else 'coach_' + feeling.lower())

add('fuel_critical', 'strategy', f'현재 소비량 기준 연료가 약 {available:.1f}랩분 남았습니다. 이번 랩에 피트로 들어오세요.', 3,
                    token=f'{lap}:{late}', cooldown=3600, phrase=('box_now' if late else 'box_end_of_lap', {}))

enclosing_conditions: fuel_add is not None and fuel_add > .1
raw_trigger_callsites.call: add('fuel_reserve', 'strategy', '현재 소비량으로 완주는 예상되지만 안전 여유분이 부족합니다. ' + fuel_advice(view, brief=True), 1, cooldown=3600)

enclosing_conditions: gap is not None and gap < 8 and trend == 'closing' and car.get('gap_at_line_s') is not None
gap is not None and gap < 5 and advantage is not None and advantage > .3 and side == 'behind' and view['pace_samples'] >= 3 and car['pace_samples'] >= 3
raw_trigger_callsites.call:
add('approach', 'race', f'같은 클래스 뒤차가 최근 {car["pace_samples"]}랩 기준 랩당 {advantage:.1f}초 빠릅니다. 거리 환산 간격은 약 {gap:.1f}초입니다.', 1, token=str(car['idx']),
                    short_text=f'같은 클래스 뒤차 페이스가 약 {advantage:.1f}초 빠릅니다.')

enclosing_conditions:
total > seen['said'] and now - seen['since'] >= 20 and left is not None and left <= 12
                    and (view.get('fuel_finish_shortfall_l') or 0) > .1
raw_trigger_callsites.call: add('finish_laps', 'strategy', priority=2, cooldown=60, token=str(total), phrase=('finish_laps_more', {}))

add('fuel_short', 'strategy', fuel_advice(view, brief=True), 2, cooldown=1800,
                    short_text=f'완주 연료 약 {view["fuel_finish_shortfall_l"]:.1f}리터 부족합니다.',
                    phrase=('fuel_short_by', {'short': math.ceil(view['fuel_finish_shortfall_l'])}))

enclosing_conditions: 3.5 < available <= 5.5 and (not pace or available * pace <= 900)
raw_trigger_callsites.call: add('pit_soon', 'strategy', priority=2, cooldown=900, phrase=('pit_soon', {}))

enclosing_conditions: 1.3 < available <= 2.5 and amount is not None and amount >= 1 and not view.get('fuel_next_stop_full')
raw_trigger_callsites.call: add('pit_fuel_plan', 'strategy', priority=2, cooldown=900, token=str(litres), phrase=('pit_fuel_add', {'liters': litres}))

enclosing_conditions: available > 2.5 and view.get('stops_needed') == 1 and not view.get('fuel_next_stop_full')
raw_trigger_callsites.call: add('pit_window', 'strategy', priority=1, cooldown=7200, phrase=('pit_window_open', {}))
add('tyre_plan', 'strategy', priority=2, cooldown=900, token=str(view.get('tyre_decision')), phrase=plan[0], also=plan[1:])

enclosing_conditions: 3.5 < available <= 5.5 and (not pace or available * pace <= 900)
raw_trigger_callsites.call:
add('pit_two', 'strategy', priority=2, cooldown=900, phrase=('pit_two', {}),
                        also=[('pit_run_dry', {})] if view.get('fuel_run_dry') else [('pit_rejoin', {'pos': rejoin})] if rejoin else ())

enclosing_conditions: available <= 2.5 and planned is not None and flags is not None and needed is not None
raw_trigger_callsites.call:
add('pit_fuel_check', 'strategy', priority=2, cooldown=1800, token=f'{round(planned)}:{"full" if full else round(needed)}',
                            phrase=('pit_fuel_full', {'liters': planned}) if full else ('pit_fuel_low', {'liters': planned, 'need': needed}))

self.radio.emit('formation_brief', now, shown, role=role, ttl=20, cooldown=0, group='formation_brief',
                            condition=('formation', None), speech_text=' '.join(parts), speech_parts=parts)

self.radio.emit('straight_brief', now, text, role=role, ttl=4, cooldown=0, group='straight_brief',
                            condition=('straight', 5. + self.BRIEF_SENTENCE_S * (len(parts) - 1)), speech_text=text, speech_parts=parts)
self.radio.emit(key, now, FIXED_CALLS[key][1], role='coach', priority=2, ttl=40, cooldown=0, speech_key=key)

self.radio.emit('repair_check', self.clock(), ' '.join(parts), role='race', priority=2, ttl=20, cooldown=0,
                            group='repair_check', speech_text=' '.join(parts), speech_parts=parts)

self.radio.emit('damage_check', self.clock(), ' '.join(parts), role='race', ttl=60, cooldown=0,
                                group='damage_check', speech_text=' '.join(parts), speech_parts=parts)

self.radio.emit('corner_focus', now, focus['text'], role='coach', ttl=CALL_EARLY_S, cooldown=20, group='corner_focus',
                                    condition=('corner_ahead', (focus['until_pct'], focus['margin_pct'])), speech_text=texts[focus['fits']])
self.radio.say(item['call'], now, role='coach', ttl=30, cooldown=600, delay=8, group='control_advice')
